title: Helper requests show up where you look

steps.path: A conversation where a helper is waiting for your OK — the bottom of the chat
steps.headline: A helper's request now appears at the bottom of the chat, like the main assistant's.
steps.changed: A "Wren the Whistling Worker wants to: …" card joins the main assistant's requests at the bottom, and the session's dot turns red for it.
steps.notice: No hunting for the helper's box further up. That box stays put; either place works.
steps.risk: Several helpers asking at once stack several cards.

steps.path: The same conversation on a phone connected to this computer
steps.headline: The phone shows the same helper request card at the bottom.
steps.changed: The same card, at phone width.
steps.notice: You can answer a helper from your phone without opening its box.
steps.risk: A long helper name wraps onto two lines on a narrow screen.
